Game Overview

In Jack in the Tower, the core idea is straightforward: guide Jack, the daring pumpkin, as he ascends a perilous tower. Test your precision and reflexes by tapping to maneuver past rolling mines, spikes, and menacing bats. Collect coins for points and brief invincibility, and challenge friends to beat your top score in this addictive arcade adventure.
